name: Ophion Club — Rose Garden
blurb: Six men in a half-circle. No powder burns. No exit wounds. Thirty yards off: a woman and a boy the report will call transients.

examine.label: The six in evening dress
examine.text: Wexford. Fenn. Corliss. Kessler. Pruitt. And one man you cannot place — watch stopped at 3:17, maker's plate filed smooth. Each: a single black hole above the bridge of the nose. No scorched collars. No answering wound at the back of the skull.

examine.label: Beyond the birches
examine.text: A woman and a boy. Clothes poor but not destitute — people who expected to be somewhere else soon. Whatever was done was not done clean. You write unidentified female, colored — unidentified male, colored, minor, presumed related. Then, too quickly: Transients.

examine.label: Under a hedge root
examine.text: Otto Kessler's boning knife, wiped too clean. Bagged. Tagged. It has never in its life been used on a hog.

name: Widow's Bight Precinct
blurb: Your desk. Odell's shadow. The file that wants a simpler shape.

examine.label: Your preliminary notes
examine.text: You wrote EIGHT in a hand deliberately larger than usual. Odell's report will say six. Whatever ends, your file will say eight.

name: St. Brendan's Parish
blurb: Incense, damp stone, a register that remembers more than it confesses.

examine.label: Parish register — Fenn
examine.text: Aldous Fenn: unusual insistence, twice, on burial beside the club rather than beside his wife. Behan's hand is steady. The margin is not.

name: Kessler's on Pickman Street
blurb: Shutters drawn. The ledger face-down. A widow who will not be steered forever.

examine.label: Shop ledger
examine.text: Withdrawals that do not match the meat trade. A line item in a private hand: CLUB — PARCEL. No amount. Only a date: last Thursday of the month.

name: Ophion Club — Bar
blurb: In uniform they pour what you order. Out of uniform they begin to talk near you.

examine.label: Membership rolls
examine.text: Five names you know. No sixth. A man can sit at that table for years and leave no more trace than a chair leaves of weight.

name: Rented Room above the Cobbler
blurb: Corkboard. Twine. Two coats by the door. A flask that does not lie about what it does.

examine.label: Private notebook
examine.text: Redundant to the board in every particular. Not because you trust the board less — because you have begun to trust yourself less than paper. Presentation can drift. Bones do not.
